Title: Entra ID SSO - Profile Assignment and Login Validation
Preconditions:
1. IGEL OS 12 device registered in UMS.
2. Entra ID SSO profile in UMS.
3. UMS bearer token available.
4. SSH enabled on device.
5. VNC/Shadow enabled.
Test_Steps:
1. Assign Entra ID SSO profile to device via UMS API.
2. Trigger device reboot via UMS API.
3. Open VNC shadow session.
4. Verify Microsoft/Entra ID login screen appears.
5. Enter valid Entra ID username + password.
6. If MFA required, enter TOTP OTP.
7. Verify device desktop loads after SSO.
8. Via SSH run: klist — verify Kerberos ticket present.
9. Unassign SSO profile, reboot, verify local login restored.
Expected_Results:
1. Entra ID login screen visible in VNC.
2. Successful login with valid credentials.
3. Desktop loads with correct user context.
4. klist shows valid Kerberos ticket.
5. After unassign: local login restored.
Automation_Notes: assign_object() for profile. OTPGenerator for MFA. OcrUiInteractor for VNC screen. SSHClientIGEL for klist. Follows QCL-3139 pattern.
